headline: Gayatri Highways Limited: Update on Sale of Stake in Associate Company
sum: Gayatri Highways Limited informed NSE of an update on the sale of its stake in an associate company pursuant to a Securities Purchase Agreement dated 12 February 2026.
implication: Associate company divestments require securities purchase agreement formality and stock exchange disclosure; monitors portfolio restructuring and capital redeployment among listed infrastructure firms.
detail: Gayatri Highways Limited filed a general corporate update with NSE on 23 June 2026 regarding progress on the sale of a stake in an associate company. The transaction is governed by a Securities Purchase Agreement executed on 12 February 2026. The filing does not disclose the identity of the associate, the buyer, the stake percentage, consideration, or closing status in the public extract.
